# SpikingNeuralNetworkBenchmarking

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A standardized framework for evaluating and comparing local learning rules on spiking neural networks across multiple tasks and metrics. Provides a common ground to assess algorithmic trade-offs, accelerating the development of deployable neuromorphic learning systems.
